answer_1.quote: We focus on generating explanations to justify opinion spam detection ... The model generates a free-text explanation e (e1, e2, ..., en) as its response.

answer_2.quote: We compute PEX consistency score (Eq 4) for each explanation ... We adopt a simulatability-based explanation faithfulness evaluation method and report simulation F1 scores.

answer_3.quote: We compute PEX consistency score using the language model M (e | Q(q, a)) and M (e | Q(q, ¬a)), treating the model as a judge of how well an explanation supports the prediction versus its negation.
